_comment: Editorial layer for Roadmap 2. Releases are the top of the hierarchy. Each release has a version, a short name, its deliverables, and one or more TRAINS (workstreams that can be built in parallel). A train of kind 'train' carries its permanent Train id; work not yet given one is kind 'bucket' and has no id. 'owner' names the lane working it and is left out when no one is. 'cars' are issue numbers in recommended assignment order, not an implicit dependency chain. 'depends_on' and 'waits_on' are the only roadmap blockers. 'backlog' holds issues reviewed and deliberately not scheduled, with the reason. Car titles and live GitHub state are refreshed; explicitly audited partial progress and relevant PRs are stored in progress_audit so incidental cross-references cannot inflate status. Page order follows version order, not list order. A Train rides one release and an issue rides one train. RATIFIED: sorted by the Architect and accepted by the Operator on 2026-10-07 ('I like the proposed map'). Targets are forecasts, never proof of shipped contents. 'firsts' is a hand-written list of the first time the project did something new in how it is built or shipped: each entry has a 'date' (YYYY-MM-DD, local), a 'title', and optionally a 'note' and an https 'url'. Every entry is printed on the public page as written, so it carries nothing private.
